comments.body: Hi @zsfelfoldi I just wanted to note we also have a breakout room starting on this day that will run on an every-other week cadence.  The breakout room is for a CL-focused effort, Fast Confirmation Rule.  It doesn't sound like there will be many people required to attend both calls, but I wanted to make you aware.  Thanks!

@will-corcoran thanks, I realized since but I also don't think there is a lot of overlap. We can change the time slot if it's a problem for anyone. Not sure yet who wants to attend and what time is ideal for them but I am open to suggestions.

Added a new item to the agenda: discussion of an alternative design suggestion now that overlaps with the current EIP-7745 but uses a much simpler search structure. This new version also has potentially better performance and delivering it can be both quicker and safer due to its relative simplicity.
